source.description: An AI-collaboration Chinese podcast with a versioned prompt-slot studio

goal.en: Publish a Mandarin podcast whose collecting, editing, voicing, artwork and production are handled by AI roles. Each role reads versioned prompt slots and writes episodes back through a scoped Agent API instead of an in-site generator.
goal.zh: 发布一档普通话播客，采集、编辑、配音、封面与制片分别由 AI 角色承担。各角色读取可版本化的提示词槽，并通过带作用域的 Agent API 写回节目，而不是在站内一键生成。

role.en: Listener site, player, transcript and admin console
role.zh: 听众站点、播放器、逐字稿与后台

role.en: Worker gateway, episode database and media delivery
role.zh: Worker 网关、节目数据库与媒体分发

role.en: Versioned role prompts with scoped read and write tokens
role.zh: 带作用域读写令牌的版本化角色提示词

description.en: Pressed fir and fern fronds spread evenly across ivory handmade paper.
